# Features Showcase

An API-only pola app demonstrating the framework improvements borrowed from
[Goyave](https://github.com/go-goyave/goyave). Every feature below is either
**generated by the `pola` CLI** or wired in a few lines of app code.

## Commands used to build this app

```bash
# 1. Scaffold an API-only app (adds a replace → local pola).
pola new features-showcase --api-only --yes --framework std --module features-showcase

#    Then: set the go.mod replace to `../..` and add a database block to
#    Polafile.hcl (adapter = sqlite, orm = gorm).

# 2. Scaffold a full resource — model, repository, service, DTOs, a DTO-flow
#    route (+ tests), and a migration, all in one command.
pola generate scaffold Product "name:string!" "price:float" "description:text" \
  --skip-action
```

Everything else is a handful of lines of app code (`main.go`, the Products
route, and `showcase.go`).

## What it demonstrates

| Improvement | Framework package | Where in this app |
|---|---|---|
| **DTOs + partial-update (PATCH)** — `Optional[T]`, `Copy`, `Convert` | `dto` | `dto/product.go` (generated) + `routes/products` handlers |
| **DTO-flow routes** — bind Create/Update DTOs, fetch→Copy→save, return response DTOs | (route generator) | `routes/products/route.go` (generated) |
| **Query-driven listing** — `?filter=…&sort=…&fields=…` | `repository` (`ParseListQuery`) | `routes/products` GET list |
| **Context-propagated transactions** | `repository/uow` + `repository/gorm` | `showcase.go` → `atomicWrites` |
| **Cross-ORM not-found → 404** | `repository.ErrNotFound` + `core.WithStatus` | `routes/products` (live) + `showcase.go` → `getOr404` |
| **CORS** (with preflight) | `middleware/cors` | `main.go` |
| **Health / readiness** — `/healthz`, `/readyz` | `middleware/health` | `main.go` |
| **Pluggable auth** — JWT authenticator, per-route protection, `UserFromContext` | `auth` | `showcase.go` → `adminRoutes`, `newAuthenticator`, `login` |
| **Per-route middleware + metadata** | `routes` (`Middlewarer`/`Metaer`) | `showcase.go` → `adminRoutes` |
| **OpenAPI 3 + SwaggerUI** | `openapi` | `showcase.go` → `serveOpenAPI` |
| **Faker-free factories** | `seed.Factory` | `showcase.go` → `productFactory`, `seedProducts` |
| **Testable clock** | `repository.WithClock` | see `repository` README |

The three that are **live** (exercisable over HTTP) are the Products CRUD
(DTOs + DTO-flow + 404), query filtering, and CORS + health. The rest are shown
as compiling, copy-pasteable snippets in `showcase.go` (functions are
intentionally uncalled) so the APIs stay honest.

## Run

```bash
go build ./...     # compiles the whole app
go test  ./...     # generated route + repository tests pass (they auto-migrate an in-memory DB)
pola serve         # starts the API; the bundled migration (db/migrations/) is
                   # embedded at build and auto-applied on boot
```

## Try it (once served)

```bash
# Create — binds dto.CreateProduct
curl -sX POST localhost:8080/products -d '{"name":"Widget","price":9.99}'

# Partial update (PATCH) — only supplied fields change; omitting "price" leaves it untouched
curl -sX PATCH localhost:8080/products/1 -d '{"name":"Renamed"}'

# Not found → 404 (neutral repository.ErrNotFound, mapped at the boundary)
curl -si localhost:8080/products/999 | head -1

# Query-driven listing
curl -s 'localhost:8080/products?filter=name||$cont||wid&sort=price,desc&per_page=5'

# CORS preflight
curl -si -X OPTIONS localhost:8080/products \
  -H 'Origin: https://app.example.com' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' | head -3

# Health / readiness
curl -s localhost:8080/healthz
curl -s localhost:8080/readyz
```
